# Limpet SDK (vendored)

Files of the Limpet SDK, used by the AROS backend to ask the console that
draws the output what it renders (colours, Amiga pens, UTF-8, size) and
which terminal it is. Unchanged copies; MIT licence in LICENSE.txt.

- Source: https://github.com/tomaszstaniak/limpet, `sdk/`
- Revision: eae72f27ff0557f901f289d6678380b606a6fa32 (main; SDK 0.6.0, not yet in a Limpet release)

Update by copying the four files from a newer Limpet SDK release; record
the revision here.
